children: Global Innovative Platforms entered into a Services Agreement with Atlas Bookkeeping on Oct 1 2026 to strengthen its finance operations and SEC reporting. Atlas will provide bookkeeping, monthly close and GAAP financials, SEC reporting support, and CFO advisory services. The company will pay $8,000 per month under an at-will arrangement terminable on 30 days' notice. Atlas is owned by David R. Wells, who was appointed Fractional CFO effective the same date.
